engineering_mitigation_measure: Taipei Seismic Zone 1; structural elastic performance without significant inelastic damage
Tunnel and stations prevent collapse; ductile detailing of diaphragm walls and segment joints

hazard_name: Lun-tou Fault (崙頭斷層) Tectonic Dislocation
engineering_mitigation_measure: Flexible segment joints and oversized clearance profile across chainage K12+850 to K13+050
Station entrance curbs set at minimum +11.30 m MSL (+1.1m freeboard); submarine flood bulkheads at shafts
Muzha portal protected by automated rising floodgates and heavy drainage sump pumps (3 x 1500 m3/h)
Songshan formation silty sands; mitigated by diaphragm walls penetrating into non-liquefiable gravel bedrock
